column1: # Inventories the server creates when a character enters the world (AddInventory 0x00df),
# in the order and with the values an official server sent (2026-10-14 capture: the batch
# after PlayerEntity, ids 1-94 then 122-144). Columns: inventory id, InventoryIdKey,
# Inventories.dat row, width, height, flags (meaning unknown). Items are not reproduced.
# The client does not start the world without the whole batch (ids 122-144 included).
